claims: Transfuse platelets for severe thrombocytopenia (platelet count 11–36 K/µL) in a critically ill, actively bleeding-risk patient.
Obtain repeat arterial blood gas to reassess refractory acidosis and hypoxemia (pH 7.11–7.14, pCO2 54–72 mmHg, pO2 58–71 mmHg on FiO2 80–90%).
Adjust mechanical ventilator settings to address severe respiratory acidosis and hypoxemia (permissive hypercapnia limits, PEEP titration).
Administer broad-spectrum antibiotics (e.g., cefepime) for suspected sepsis with fever up to 40.4°C, leukocytosis, and bandemia.
Obtain blood cultures and repeat sputum cultures to identify infection source.
Monitor vancomycin trough level (18.5–21.5 µg/mL) and adjust dosing for renal impairment (creatinine 1.9–2.2 mg/dL).
Continue vasopressor support (norepinephrine, vasopressin, phenylephrine) and monitor hemodynamics given lactic acidosis (lactate 3.3–5.8 mmol/L) and hypotension risk.
Monitor and manage hyperphosphatemia (phosphate 6.8–7.5 mg/dL) and hypocalcemia (ionized calcium 1.03–1.07 mmol/L) with calcium supplementation.
Perform tracheal suctioning and subglottic suctioning to maintain airway clearance in intubated patient.
Maintain targeted temperature management with Arctic Sun device and monitor core temperature (febrile to 40.4°C).
